Architecture/block diagram (Figure 2.4 "Refactored IG1373 SD-WAN OSI Layered Service Model"), one of three related views derived from the same underlying "Gliffy master diagram" (the others being `sdwan-osi-layered-service-model-mef-mapping-view.png` and the canonical `sdwan-osi-layered-service-model-canonical-full.png`). This view shows the full IP/underlay transport layer (MPLS, Internet, cellular clouds) but does not show the L0 physical-infrastructure detail (SFP, GPON, DWDM, ducts) that the canonical view shows.

Layout: a set of horizontal "planes" — Management Plane, Control Plane L3, Control Plane L3/2.5, Control Plane L2, User Plane L1, Infrastructure Plane L0 — spans the diagram, with a lettered A–H key at the bottom-left (A: SD-WAN UNI, B: SD-WAN Edge, C: SWVC SD-WAN Virtual Connection, D: UCS Underlay Connectivity Service, E: UCS UNI, F: SWVC EP, G: TVC Tunnel Virtual Connection, H: Internet Breakout).

Within these planes, nested green-dashed domain boxes contain: an **"e2e Service Management Operational Domain"** with a **"Service Management Intelligent Controller (SMIC)"** box at the top (annotated "NaaS API: TMF 909, TMF921, TMF640(Intent)"); an **"SD-WAN Operational Domain / SD-WAN Technology Domain"** containing a **"Provider Edge Router"** (left, Customer Operational Domain) and a **"Virtual Provider Edge Router"** (right, Customer Operational Domain), connected via "SD-WAN Overlay Service" and an "SDWAN Controller" device labelled "Service Model MEF SDWAN Service 70.1/70.2", linked by "SD-WAN Virtual Connection (SWDC)" and two "TVC" lines (TVC (UCS#1) cyan, TVC (UCS#2) orange) down to "UCS UNI" / "UnderlayConnectivity Service (UCS)" lines.
- Below that, an **"IP Underlay Service"** box with an "IPVC Controller" device, and cloud icons for "MPLS", "internet", and "cellular" bridging across to the right-hand Virtual Provider Edge Router side (which also shows "Intent Breakout" and a "Private or Virtual Cloud" cloud icon).
- At the bottom, a **"Physical and Line Plant Technology Domain"** box containing "Fibre Transport Service" and "Fibre Management System & Inventory" boxes (left) plus, further down, "Line plant Mngt System & Inventory" and "Infrastructure Service" boxes.
- On the outer edges, "Subscriber Network Site A" and "Subscriber Network Site B" cloud icons connect in via "SD-WAN UNI" lines.

This is the version of the layered model used to illustrate the OSI-layer positioning of the SD-WAN service before the MEF-specific service model is overlaid (compare the mapped view).
